notes.title: Demo Update 1.5.1
notes.content:
Demo is updated to version 1.5.1 with these changes:
* Mouse controls are polished, now they are fluid and perfect!
* Potato now gets ragdolled when died.
* Cutscene fast-forward and rewind effects are remade.
* Fixed the squash and stretch effect when hit enemies.
* Pick-up sound effect changed.
* “Got item” animations are remade.
* Fixed some cutscene triggers.
* Some environmental changes.
* Some minor fixes.

notes.title: New Update For Demo!
notes.content:
We're trying to create the best version of Potato Mash ever can be! So, with weeks of work; we have managed to improve the demo even further!

Update Notes (v1.3.0)

Notable:
[list]
[*] Added saving indicators to show that the game is being saved.
[*] Added checkpoints for: Mike’s fight, after greasing, each wave of the final fights .
[*] Added “switch on the lights” section before the recording.
[*] Now we see through the pipes in the park when we go inside them.
[/list]
Graphics:
[list]
[*] Redesigned the movie studio.
[*] Redesigned “low health screen effects” for being more harsh.
[*] Changed the room labels to room icons in corridors.
[*] Changed objective texts style a bit.
[*] Redesigned “failed” text.
[*] Added lights to the fireballs.
[*] Added animations for the moustaches getting greased.
[*] Changed some tutorial posters from text to visual only.
[*] Added LUT for a more balanced and atmospheric look.
[/list]
Sound:
[olist]
[*] Fixed the music players.
[*] Fixed the oiling sounds.
[*] Fixed ambient sounds.
[*] Fixed brown bat sound.
[*] Fixed pimp burning sounds.
[/olist]
Game Design:
[list]
[*] The game is now a bit easier because of the checkpoints and the see-through pipe. 
[/list]
Language:
[list]
[*] Now the posters are localized too.​
[*] Fixes for several languages.
[/list]
Technical Improvements and Fixes:
[list]
[*] Optimized for better performance.
[*] Several other minor fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: BIG UPDATE FOR THE DEMO!
notes.content:
Since we want you to have the best possible experience on Potato Mash!, we have updated the demo with the a pack of new features and fixes!

Update Notes (v1.12)
Features:
* Integrated Steam Leaderboards to “BING!”, the math game.
* Added a punch machine both for tutorial and practicing.
* Added a full-fledged menu with huge re-design; which has more controls over audio and graphics settings.
Technical Improvements and Fixes:
* Now the game renders with one camera instead of two cameras. So performance will be improved, the ordering issues among the layers are fixed, and the characters are now affected by lighting and visual effects.
* Fixed the “Default” line from Ice Cream’s cutscene.
* Fixed the healing when paused
* Ground collisions are fixed now. There will be no objects going down there.
Language:
* Added Turkish, Ukrainian and Russian, Hungarian language support
Sound:
* Sound effects added for picking up power ups and healing.
* Added music to the Dog’s cutscene.
* Added a music before the music video recording part.
* Reworked the fight music of Chicken Mike.
* Reworked the intro music.
* Reworked the menu music.
Game Design:
* Decreased the difficulty of final part.
* Decreased the healing speed but increased the healing amount.
Graphics:
* Most of the characters are redesigned and given them more detail.
* Ice Cream’s room is now more detailed.
* Added visual effects added for healing.
* More posters added.
Other: 
* Now the game has its own fictional illness.
